Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Test User
Message:
fix(m12): commit the demo Secret so the honest-limits beat reproduces

The deep dive proves that read-only RBAC still grants get on Secrets by
reading one. That Secret existed only in the cluster it was first measured
on - created ad hoc, with no manifest anywhere in the repo - so on a
learner's fresh cluster the read returned NotFound and the module's best
beat demonstrated nothing.

The value is deliberately fake and safe to commit; the manifest says so,
and notes that base64 is an encoding rather than encryption, which is part
of what the exercise measures.

Verified by deleting the ad-hoc Secret, re-running the injector, and
reading it back under the read-only identity:
  sk-demo-not-real-12345

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
